// Package netGuard builds an http.Client that enforces a network grant of
// hosts (and optionally private addressing) per remote MCP server.
package netguard

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// Grant is what one remote server may reach.
type Grant struct {
	Hosts        []string // host or host:port, exact case-insensitive match; bare host allows any port
	AllowPrivate bool     // allow loopback, private and link-local (only for servers on such an address)
}

// ErrNotGranted is returned (wrapped) for any refused connection.
var ErrNotGranted = errors.New("netGuard: host not granted")

type grantErr struct{ host string }

func (e grantErr) Error() string  { return fmt.Sprintf("%w: %s", ErrNotGranted, e.host) }
func (e grantErr) Unwrap() error  { return ErrNotGranted }

// Client returns an http.Client that only connects to hosts the server is granted.
func Client(g Grant, timeout time.Duration) *http.Client {
	tr := &http.Transport{DialContext: makeDialer(g)}
	c := &http.Client{Timeout: timeout, Transport: tr}
	c.CheckRedirect = func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
		if len(via) >= 5 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: too many redirects", ErrNotGranted)
		}
		if !hostGranted(g.Hosts, req.URL.String()) {
			return grantErr{req.URL.Hostname()}
		}
		if via[0].URL.Scheme == "https" && req.URL.Scheme == "http" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: https→http redirect", ErrNotGranted)
		}
		return nil
	}
	return c
}

func makeDialer(g Grant) func(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error) {
	d := &net.Dialer{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
	return func(ctx context.Context, _ string, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
		host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
		if err != nil {
			host = addr
		}
		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && !g.AllowPrivate && isPriv(ip) {
			return nil, grantErr{host}
		}
		return d.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", addr)
	}
}

// hostGranted checks whether the URL's raw host (with or without port) matches
// any entry in hosts. A bare host grants any port; a host:port grants that port only.
func hostGranted(hosts []string, raw string) bool {
	for _, h := range hosts {
		if strings.EqualFold(h, raw) {
			return true
		}
		if !strings.ContainsRune(h, ':') {
			tgt := raw
			if i := strings.Index(tgt, ":"); i >= 0 {
				tgt = tgt[:i]
			}
			if strings.EqualFold(tgt, h) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

// isPriv reports whether ip is loopback, RFC-1918 private, link-local,
// unspecified or multicast.
func isPriv(ip net.IP) bool {
	if v4 := ip.To4(); v4 != nil {
		switch {
		case v4[0] == 127: // 127.0.0.0/8 loopback
			return true
		case v4[0] == 10: // RFC-1918 10.0.0.0/8
			return true
		case v4[0] == 172 && v4[1]&0xF0 == 16<<4: // 172.16.0.0/12
			return true
		case v4[0] == 192 && v4[1] == 168: // 192.168.0.0/16
			return true
		case v4[0] == 169 && v4[1] == 254: // link-local 169.254.0.0/16
			return true
		case (v4[0] & 0xE0) == 0xE0: // multicast 224.0.0.0/4
			return true
		case v4[0] == 0 && v4[1] == 0 && v4[2] == 0 && v4[3] == 0: // unspecified
			return true
		default:
			return false
		}
	}
	switch {
	case ip.Equal(net.IPv6loopback):     // ::1/128
		return true
	case ip.Equal(net.IPv6unspecified):  // ::/128
		return true
	case (ip[0] == 0xfe) && (ip[1]&0xc0 == 0x80): // fe80::/10 link-local
		return true
	case (ip[0] & 0xff) == 0xfc:        // fc00::/7 ULA
		return true
	case (ip[0] & 0xff) == 0xff:        // ff00::/8 multicast
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
